transmitterSigns.policy: Unambiguous single known_nt annotation takes precedence; otherwise GABA and GLUT inhibitory, other predictions excitatory. Mixed known_nt labels fall back to prediction. Modulatory transmitters are simplified, not receptor-specific.

adaptations: 0.2 ms timestep (reference Brian2 default is 0.1 ms)
Event-sparse state with 1e-8 mV idle tolerance
FlyWire v783 packaged graph rather than reference connectivity files
DM1-only external odor input; no visual, wind or heading encoders
Artificial DNa02 steering and provisional exact-cell-type DNp09 walking decoder
No Brian2 equivalence or behavioral reproduction claimed
Unambiguous literature known_nt overrides conflicting transmitter predictions
